[P2] Follow RDS pagination before rejecting an engine version

`DescribeDBEngineVersions` is paginated, but this reads only the first page and ignores its `Marker`. When RDS returns additional pages, a configured version on a later page is incorrectly reported as unavailable, blocking synthesis and deployment; the suggested alternatives are also incomplete. Follow `Marker` until the catalog is exhausted, or use the SDK paginator, before concluding that the version is absent. Add a test whose requested version appears on the second page.
